mastery.task: Make a simple protocol classifier for HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, IMAP and unknown values; explain why a classifier is not a security guarantee.
mastery.hint: Test each known string and include a default.
mastery.answer: HTTP web, HTTPS encrypted web, SMTP sending mail, IMAP retrieving/synchronising mail, unknown remains unrecognised. Treat user input case appropriately.
